instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: General contractor specializing in multi-family residential projects and light commercial builds. We manage 6-8 active construction sites simultaneously with a network of 30+ subcontractors. Current focus is on BIM adoption and drone-based site progress monitoring. Multi-department organization with formalized budgets, quarterly business reviews, and a dedicated strategy function. We have invested in core systems (ERP, CRM, HRIS) but these are not always well-integrated. Innovation is a standing agenda item at board level with annual investment allocated, but execution velocity varies across business units.
answers.pastInitiatives: We launched a digital customer onboarding flow last quarter that reduced average onboarding time from 12 days to 5 days. The project was cross-functional involving product, compliance, and customer success teams. Early NPS scores for new customers onboarded through this flow are 22 points higher than the legacy process.
answers.strategicGoals: Our primary objective is to reduce operating expenses by 15% over the next 2 years while maintaining current output levels. We believe there is significant waste in our manual processes and want to identify the highest-ROI automation opportunities across order processing, invoicing, and customer support workflows. We are not looking to grow headcount — we want to do more with our existing team.
answers.teamSize: The technology organization is structured into product-aligned squads with a central platform team of 5 engineers enabling shared infrastructure. Innovation is driven by a '20% time' policy where all engineers can dedicate one day per sprint to self-directed projects, plus a quarterly internal pitch competition where winning ideas receive seed funding and 3 months of dedicated squad allocation.
answers.additionalContext: We completed a merger with a similarly-sized competitor 4 months ago and are in the middle of integrating teams, systems, and processes. The combined organization has significant duplication — two CRMs, two HR systems, overlapping product lines. There is a unique window to redesign processes from scratch rather than patching legacy approaches, but cultural integration is fragile and change fatigue is real.

input.changes_since_last: Hired 3 new team members. Launched customer feedback pilot. Budget for innovation increased 10%.

opportunities.title: Enterprise Architecture Rationalization & Core System Unification
opportunities.rationale: The merger has created critical data silos (2 CRMs, 2 HR systems) and process duplication. Before significant automation can occur, a foundational architectural clean-up is mandatory to establish a single source of truth for customer, vendor, and employee data. This must be the highest priority initiative.

first_actions: Establish an Executive Steering Committee (ESC) with mandate authority over system retirement/selection.
Conduct a Gap Analysis comparing all redundant systems against ideal unified requirements.
Define the Canonical Data Model for key entities (Customer, Project, Subcontractor).
execution_plan.success_metric: Operational decommissioning of 2 redundant core systems within 9 months.
milestones: Selection of the 'System of Record' for CRM and HRIS.
Data cleansing plan documented for migrating all historical data.
Proof-of-Concept (PoC) deployment in a non-critical area.

opportunities.title: End-to-End Order-to-Cash (O2C) Automation Blueprinting
opportunities.rationale: The strategic goal of 15% OpEx reduction points directly to automating manual processes in invoicing and order processing. This opportunity focuses on mapping the most wasteful stages of the current O2C process flow, minimizing human touchpoints.

first_actions: Process mapping workshop involving Finance, Procurement, and Project Management leads.
Identify all manual data handoffs between project site completion (BIM/Drone) and billing system (ERP).
Pilot automated trigger generation for invoice drafts upon measurable project milestones.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in average time taken from site completion verification to invoice submission by 50%.
milestones: Selection and deployment of initial RPA bot for data entry/validation.
Successful dry run of automated invoicing cycle.

next_steps.action: Mandate the formation of a dedicated, cross-functional Integration Task Force (ITF) with executive sponsorship to prioritize system rationalization and data governance.
Conduct a deep-dive value stream mapping exercise specifically on the Order-to-Cash process, benchmarking current manual steps against industry best practices for immediate OpEx identification.
Operationalize the success of the digital onboarding flow by creating standardized process documentation and training modules for all business units to replicate efficiency gains.

key_weaknesses: Fragile organizational integration due to recent merger, leading to change fatigue and process resistance.
Severe system redundancy and data fragmentation across multiple core platforms (ERP, CRM, HRIS).
Lack of standardized operational processes post-merger, causing friction between departments.

improvements: Demonstrated immediate efficiency gains via the digital customer onboarding flow (12 to 5 days reduction; +22 NPS points).
Innovation is now structured with dedicated '20% time' for engineers, fostering internal idea generation.
Clear quantitative focus on OpEx reduction provides strong operational direction.
persistent_gaps: System incompatibility and data duplication remain the primary blocker to scalable efficiency gains.
Lack of clear decision authority regarding system decommissioning/selection post-merger.
Integration efforts are focused on 'patching' rather than fundamental process redesign.
achieved_milestones: Successful cross-functional launch and adoption of the new digital customer onboarding flow.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: The company has shifted from general process improvement awareness to executing tangible digital wins (onboarding flow). However, the merger introduces massive systemic complexity and data fragmentation risk, shifting the focus from minor optimization to critical architectural overhaul.
